error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if the run failed, otherwise None.

console.title: Console
console.description: Captured console output lines from the script execution.

type.title: Type
type.description: Lua type of the variable's value.

value.title: Value
value.description: String representation of the variable's value, if available.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Additional metadata about the variable, if any.

children.title: Children
children.description: Nested child variables (e.g. table fields), if the value is a compound type.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Captured local variables of main() at the end of execution.

404.description: Node not found, or the requested script was not found inside the node's directory

500.description: luajit not found on the server, or the test runner harness is missing

503.description: Lua runtime not built. Run `make linkiir` in the runtime directory.
